title: Eleven Letters a Week, Signed by Nobody
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：writer　|　正文 310 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 writer 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandmother was not a ① writer, by which I mean she never wrote a book; she wrote for everybody in the street for thirty-one years — letters to the council, letters to sons, eleven a week — and never signed one of them. The ② writer of the letter, on the forms the council sent back, was always the person who had asked, and she said that was the whole point.

The ③ writer of the book my father loved, and he loved exactly one, was a man from eleven miles away; my father wrote to him in 1961 and received a reply of eleven words, which he kept until 1998. My grandmother never had ④ writer's block, and she said the reason was that she never wrote anything she wanted to write.

She was the ⑤ letter writer of the street, and a ⑥ writer of hymns — eleven of them, sung at the chapel for thirty-one years, and nobody knew they were hers. In 1974 she was the ⑦ speech writer for a man standing for the council, and he lost, and she said the speech had been the best thing about him.

She was, before anything else, a ⑧ writer in the plainest sense: a person with a pen who could make a shape other people could read, and in 1961 that was still a rare thing in a village, and no writer, she said, is ever paid for the writing.

The ⑨ writer I became, and I am one, writes alone and signs everything, and I have never written a letter for anybody in my life. The ⑩ writer she was wrote eleven letters a week for thirty-one years and signed none of them, and the writer, she said, is the least of it, and I have decided that is not modesty, and I have also decided that I do not know what it is.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. （信件、文件的）执笔人；具名人
C. n. （某类文稿的）撰写人；写手
D. n. 会写字的人；书写者
E. 固定搭配：the writer of ... ……的作者
F. 固定搭配：a writer of ... 写……的人
G. 固定搭配：speech writer 演讲稿撰写人
H. 固定搭配：writer's block 写作障碍；文思枯竭

items.q: My grandmother was not a writer
The writer of the letter, on the forms
The writer of the book my father loved
My grandmother never had writer's block
She was the letter writer of the street
she was the speech writer for a man
a writer in the plainest sense
The writer I became, and I am one
The writer she was wrote eleven letters

answers.why: a writer 意为“作家、作者”，祖母算不上作家，意思是她从未写过一本书。
the writer of the letter 意为“信件的执笔人、具名人”，议会寄回的表格上，信件具名人永远是来求她的那个人。
the writer of the book 意为“那本书的作者”，我父亲唯一喜欢的那本书的作者是十一英里外的一个人。
writer's block 意为“写作障碍、文思枯竭”，祖母从来没有文思枯竭，她说原因是她从不写自己想写的东西。
letter writer 意为“代人写信的人、书信写手”，她是那条街上代人写信的人。
a writer of hymns 意为“写赞美诗的人”，她还写过十一首赞美诗。
speech writer 意为“演讲稿撰写人”，1974 年她为一个竞选议会席位的人写演讲稿。
a writer 意为“会写字的人、书写者”，最朴素的意义上，她就是一个能写出别人认得出的字的人。
the writer 意为“作家”，我后来成了的那种作家独自写作，什么都署名。
the writer 意为“（她那样的）写作者、作家”，她那样的写作者三十一年里每周写十一封信，一封也不署名。

The writer of the letter, on the forms the council sent back, was always the person who had asked.

She was the letter writer of the street, and a writer of hymns, eleven of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 writer 的 3 种不同用法；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: My grandmother was not a writer, and the writer of the letter, on the forms the council sent back, was always the person who had asked.
The writer of the book my father loved was a man from eleven miles away, and my grandmother never had writer's block.
She was the letter writer of the street and a writer of hymns, eleven of them, sung at the chapel for thirty-one years.
In 1974 she was the speech writer for a man standing for the council, and he lost.
She was, before anything else, a writer in the plainest sense: a person with a pen who could make a shape other people could read.
The writer I became writes alone and signs everything, and the writer she was signed none of the eleven letters she wrote each week.
